snippet.title: May 18th Morning Devotional, Serving One Another
snippet.description:
We are excited to have our week of prayer and fasting. Today (May 18th) is day 3 of our week and we are looking at Eph. 4:16. Alex Kerford one of our members will be encouraging us. Subscribe to get updates every morning this week!

We will have live streamed prayer meetings Monday-Friday at 6pm and Saturday at 9am.

For more information and resources go to jubileestl.org/fasting.
